rationale: The concentrated limiter was the absence of an asymmetric control point or measured buying advantage over established wearable CROs, while the proposed clinic exclusivity and reusable benchmark rights were both unproven. The redesign replaces speculative broad foundry execution with a single-endpoint, sponsor-precommitted consortium that does not launch until multiple sponsor deposits, a costed clinic and qualified-role agreement, a documented regulatory route, and lawful cross-sponsor derived-benchmark rights are in place. This changes the payer event, offer, distribution gate, data compounding logic and economics without claiming that any commitment, right, price, conversion, renewal or cost reduction has been obtained. If the gates fail, the study does not proceed.
